source_caption:
This film is based on the true story of the GameStop surge, where everyday investors took on Wall Street and, for a moment, shook the system.

It follows online traders turning a risky bet into a full-blown financial revolt, as a joke investment spirals into something that rattles billion-dollar hedge funds.

What starts as internet chaos quickly becomes a real clash between ordinary people and powerful financial institutions.
-
📽️: Dumb Money (2023)
Dir. Craig Gillespie

source_details.title: Dumb Money
source_details.synopsis: Dumb Money is a 2023 American biographical comedy-drama film, directed by Craig Gillespie and written by Lauren Schuker Blum and Rebecca Angelo. It is based on the 2021 book The Antisocial Network by Ben Mezrich and chronicles the GameStop short squeeze of January 2021. The film features an ensemble cast that includes Paul Dano, Pete Davidson, Vincent D'Onofrio, America Ferrera, Nick Offerman, Anthony Ramos, Sebastian Stan, Shailene Woodley, and Seth Rogen. After being filmed in New Jersey from October to November 2022, Dumb Money premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 8, 2023.
